title: Implement Real-Time 1v1 Battle Engine and Matchmaking

   - 10s timer per question.
   - Real-time scoring (Base + Speed + Streak).
   - Elo updates and Tribe point allocation after battle completion.
3. Handle edge cases: player disconnect, timeouts, and forfeits.
Refer to ARCHITECTURE.md and PRD.md for timing and formulas.

4. Define the 'Overtaken' mechanics: How close does a rival have to be for a notification to trigger?
5. Output to /home/team/shared/RETENTION_MECHANICS.md.

title: Backend: Rank Decay Engine & Streak Tracking Implementation
description:

2. Build the streak tracking logic (last_login_at, current_streak_count).
3. Implement a 'Rank Monitor' that triggers a notification when a user's rank changes (up or down) relative to their immediate rivals in their Tribe.
4. Ensure the IQ Profile API returns the 'Decay Countdown' (time until rank slips).

title: UI/UX: Urgency & Status Pressure Visuals
